headline: Robert Bosch GmbH files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Robert Bosch GmbH has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 with the NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights in Bosch Home Comfort India Limited (BHCIL).
detail: Robert Bosch GmbH, the German multinational manufacturing and automotive systems supplier, has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure when a person (or persons acting in concert) acquires or intends to acquire shares or voting rights that result in a change of control or cross specified thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75%). The disclosure signals a material change in shareholding or control architecture in BHCIL, a subsidiary or associate entity within the Bosch group in India. No consideration amount or share count is disclosed in the filing abstract; the full disclosure document would contain shareholding patterns, acquirer identification, and applicable exemptions.

triggers.note: Disclosure of substantial acquisition is mandatory; triggers investigation of whether 25% open offer threshold or other control-event thresholds have been crossed.
